newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Banque Indosuez to expand Asia fixed income team.
newsitem.headline: Banque Indosuez to expand Asia fixed income team.

text.p: France's Banque Indosuez said on Friday it had appointed Paul Skinner as head of fixed income sales for Southeast Asia as part of a plan to expand its Asia fixed income team.
Skinner, based in Singapore, will report to Robert Appleby, the regional head of fixed income sales who will be transferred to Hong Kong by the end of the month, the bank said in a statement.
It said the new appointment was in line with the bank's aim to broaden its product range and become a leader in raising debt for Asian borrowers.
A Banque Indosuez spokesman said the bank planned to expand its 30-member Asian fixed income team to about 40-50 people in the next few months, with priority given to Indonesia and Thailand.
